composition_summary: L-Methylfolate 5 mg + Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg + Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate 0.5 mg Tablets
short_description: FOLATIS combines active folate with methylcobalamin and pyridoxal phosphate to support folate and vitamin B12 status.
full_description: FOLATIS combines active folate with methylcobalamin and pyridoxal phosphate to support folate and vitamin B12 status. It helps meet specific nutritional needs involved in red blood cell formation, homocysteine metabolism and normal nerve function, when used under medical supervision alongside a balanced diet.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Folate and Vitamin B12 Supplementation
benefits.description: Helps meet increased folate and vitamin B12 requirements and address inadequate dietary intake.

benefits.title: Blood and Nerve Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Supports normal red blood cell formation, homocysteine metabolism and nerve function.

mechanisms.title: Supplies Active Coenzymes
mechanisms.description: Methylfolate, methylcobalamin and pyridoxal phosphate provide biologically active forms of folate, vitamin B12 and vitamin B6.

mechanisms.title: Supports One-Carbon Metabolism
mechanisms.description: These nutrients participate in DNA synthesis and pathways that convert homocysteine to other compounds.

mechanisms.title: Supports Blood and Nerve Function
mechanisms.description: Correcting relevant deficiencies supports normal red blood cell production and nerve function.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin B12 Assessment
safety_sections.description: Anaemia or neurological symptoms need assessment. Folate can improve blood counts while untreated vitamin B12 deficiency continues to damage nerves.

safety_sections.title: Duplicate Supplements and Medicines
safety_sections.description: Review prenatal vitamins, antiepileptics and methotrexate with the clinician. Do not combine high-dose folate products without advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Individual Requirements
safety_sections.description: Use the prescribed folate form and dose during pregnancy. High-dose supplementation is appropriate only for an identified clinical need.

composition_summary: Dydrogesterone 10 mg per tablet
short_description: Duvia™-10 contains dydrogesterone, an oral progestogen used in conditions associated with insufficient progesterone activity.
full_description: Duvia™-10 contains dydrogesterone, an oral progestogen used in conditions associated with insufficient progesterone activity. It acts on the uterine lining to support normal hormonal responses. The tablet is used in the management of menstrual disorders, endometriosis and luteal-phase support as part of prescribed gynaecological care.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults — irregular cycles: take 1 tablet (10 mg) twice daily on cycle days 11–25. Endometriosis: take 1 tablet twice daily on days 5–25 or continuously under the selected treatment plan. Infertility due to luteal insufficiency: take 1 tablet twice daily on days 11–25 for at least 6 cycles. The prescriber must select one indication-specific schedule.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water, with or without food. Day 1 is the first day of menstrual bleeding. Space divided doses evenly. Pregnancy or assisted-reproduction support requires a separate specialist protocol; do not stop it independently.

benefits.title: Menstrual Disorders
benefits.description: Management of irregular menstrual cycles, dysmenorrhoea and dysfunctional uterine bleeding associated with progesterone insufficiency.

benefits.title: Endometriosis
benefits.description: Management of endometriosis-related symptoms through progestogenic activity.

benefits.title: Luteal-Phase Support
benefits.description: Provides progesterone-related support in specialist fertility treatment.

mechanisms.title: Activates Progesterone Receptors
mechanisms.description: Dydrogesterone binds to progesterone receptors in responsive tissues, particularly the uterine lining.

mechanisms.title: Changes the Endometrial Response
mechanisms.description: It promotes a progesterone-type response in an oestrogen-primed endometrium.

mechanisms.title: Supports the Prescribed Cycle
mechanisms.description: This helps regulate bleeding patterns or provide progestogenic support according to the treatment protocol.

safety_sections.title: Unexplained Bleeding and Tumours
safety_sections.description: Do not start before unexplained vaginal bleeding is investigated. Avoid with known or suspected progestogen-dependent tumours.

safety_sections.title: Liver Disease and Allergy
safety_sections.description: Inform the prescriber about liver disease. Stop and seek review for jaundice, severe abdominal pain or an allergic reaction.

safety_sections.title: Individual Pregnancy and Hormone Assessment
safety_sections.description: Pregnancy, breastfeeding and concurrent oestrogen therapy require individual review. Persistent breakthrough bleeding needs investigation.

short_description: Feoma™-XT combines ferrous ascorbate with folic acid and zinc for iron supplementation and blood-forming nutritional support.
full_description: Feoma™-XT combines ferrous ascorbate with folic acid and zinc for iron supplementation and blood-forming nutritional support. Iron contributes to haemoglobin production and oxygen transport, while folate supports cell division and red blood cell development. Zinc contributes to normal cellular function, complementing nutritional care during increased requirements.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Review the duration against the identified nutritional need and response.

Administration Advice
Take with water. Iron is better absorbed away from meals but may be taken after food if it causes nausea. Avoid tea, coffee, calcium and antacids near the dose.

benefits.title: Iron Deficiency and Iron-Deficiency Anaemia

benefits.title: Increased Iron and Folate Requirements
benefits.description: Supports nutritional requirements during pregnancy and periods of increased blood-forming demand under medical supervision.

mechanisms.title: Provides Absorbable Iron
mechanisms.description: Iron supplies the mineral needed to produce haemoglobin in developing red blood cells.

mechanisms.title: Supports Cell Production
mechanisms.description: Folate and other supplied micronutrients contribute to normal cell division and blood formation.

mechanisms.title: Replenishes Nutrient Stores
mechanisms.description: Continued prescribed supplementation helps restore iron stores and correct deficiency-related symptoms over time.

safety_sections.title: Iron Overload and Non-Iron Anaemia
safety_sections.description: Avoid in haemochromatosis or iron overload. Confirm the cause of anaemia before treatment. Not every low haemoglobin level is due to iron deficiency.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Effects and Accidental Ingestion
safety_sections.description: Nausea, constipation and dark stools may occur. Iron overdose can be fatal in children. Store securely out of their reach.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Separate from levothyroxine by at least 4 hours and from interacting antibiotics as directed. Monitor haemoglobin and iron stores.

Swallow with water, preferably away from tea, coffee and calcium. Take after a meal if stomach discomfort occurs.

composition_summary: Myo-Inositol 1800 mg + Magnesium Sulphate 600 mg + Ashwagandha root extract 525 mg N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine 450 mg + Inositol 45 mg + Zinc 13.2 mg Chromium picolinate 400 mcg + Vitamin D2 plant source 600 IU Powder
short_description: Chromolyn™ combines myo-inositol, N-acetylcysteine, ashwagandha, magnesium, zinc, chromium and vitamin D2 for women’s nutritional support.
full_description: Chromolyn™ combines myo-inositol, N-acetylcysteine, ashwagandha, magnesium, zinc, chromium and vitamin D2 for women’s nutritional support. The formulation brings together ingredients involved in cellular signalling, nutrient metabolism and antioxidant pathways. It complements balanced dietary intake and clinician-directed nutritional care for women with metabolic and reproductive concerns.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take this powder in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Mix the prescribed measured serving in water and consume promptly after a meal. Do not estimate a serving using an uncalibrated household spoon.

benefits.title: Nutritional Support in PCOS Care
benefits.description: Complements dietary and lifestyle management for women with PCOS through supplemental inositol and micronutrient intake.

benefits.title: Micronutrient Supplementation
benefits.description: Helps meet magnesium, zinc, chromium and vitamin D requirements when dietary intake is inadequate.

mechanisms.title: Supports Cellular Signalling
mechanisms.description: Myo-inositol participates in intracellular pathways involved in insulin and reproductive hormone signalling.

mechanisms.title: Provides Antioxidant Substrates
mechanisms.description: N-acetylcysteine supplies cysteine for glutathione synthesis. Other ingredients provide additional nutritional support.

mechanisms.title: Supports Assessed Nutrient Needs
mechanisms.description: Magnesium, zinc, chromium and vitamin D contribute to normal physiological processes when intake is inadequate.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Thyroid and Liver Disease
safety_sections.description: Avoid during pregnancy unless specifically cleared. Ashwagandha may affect thyroid function and has been linked to rare liver injury.

safety_sections.title: Glucose and Medicine Interactions
safety_sections.description: Review diabetes medicines, sedatives, thyroid treatment and immunosuppressants. Monitor glucose if receiving glucose-lowering therapy.

safety_sections.title: Serving Size and Tolerance
safety_sections.description: Confirm the powder serving and elemental mineral amounts. Excess magnesium may cause diarrhoea, particularly in kidney impairment.

composition_summary: Highly purified Human Chorionic Gonadotropin 5000 IU Injection
short_description: Humiphin™ contains highly purified human chorionic gonadotropin, a hormone with luteinising hormone-like activity.
full_description: Humiphin™ contains highly purified human chorionic gonadotropin, a hormone with luteinising hormone-like activity. It triggers final follicular maturation and ovulation in specialist fertility treatment. In men with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, it stimulates testicular testosterone production. The injectable preparation forms part of a specialist-directed hormonal treatment programme.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Ovulation trigger in adult women: administer 5000–10000 IU once after adequate follicular development; each vial supplies 5000 IU. Use ultrasound and hormone monitoring to determine the exact trigger time.

Administration Advice
A trained healthcare professional must reconstitute the required vial(s) with the supplied diluent and administer by the route authorised for the pack. Do not assume that an intramuscular-only preparation is suitable for subcutaneous use.

benefits.title: Ovulation Induction
benefits.description: Triggers final follicular maturation and ovulation following ovarian stimulation in fertility treatment.

benefits.title: Male Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism
benefits.description: Stimulates testicular testosterone production as part of specialist hormonal management.

mechanisms.title: Mimics the LH Signal
mechanisms.description: hCG activates luteinising hormone receptors in the ovary or testis.

mechanisms.title: Stimulates Gonadal Function
mechanisms.description: It promotes final oocyte maturation and ovulation or stimulates Leydig-cell testosterone production.

mechanisms.title: Supports the Treatment Objective
mechanisms.description: Carefully timed administration supports the fertility or endocrine protocol selected by the specialist.

safety_sections.title: Ovarian Hyperstimulation and Clots
safety_sections.description: Seek urgent care for severe abdominal swelling, rapid weight gain, breathlessness or reduced urine. Ovarian hyperstimulation can cause thrombosis.

safety_sections.title: Multiple Pregnancy and Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Ultrasound and hormonal monitoring are required during ovarian stimulation. Multiple pregnancy and ovarian torsion risks need counselling.

safety_sections.title: Hormone-Sensitive Conditions
safety_sections.description: Avoid in relevant hormone-dependent tumours, unexplained genital bleeding or unsuitable uncontrolled endocrine disorders. Disclose all fertility medicines.

composition_summary: Ondansetron - Mouth Dissolving 4 mg Tablet
short_description: Throfree™ contains ondansetron in a mouth-dissolving tablet for prevention and control of treatment-related nausea and vomiting.
full_description: Throfree™ contains ondansetron in a mouth-dissolving tablet for prevention and control of treatment-related nausea and vomiting. Ondansetron blocks serotonin 5-HT3 receptors involved in the vomiting reflex. The formulation is used in prescribed antiemetic care associated with cancer chemotherapy, radiotherapy and surgical procedures.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Moderately emetogenic chemotherapy — adults and ages 12–17: take 8 mg (2 tablets) 30 minutes before chemotherapy and again 8 hours later, then 8 mg every 12 hours for 1–2 days afterwards. Ages 4–11: give 4 mg (1 tablet) before chemotherapy and 4 and 8 hours later, then 4 mg three times daily for 1–2 days. Severe liver impairment: maximum 8 mg/day. Radiotherapy and surgery require their own prescribed schedules.

Administration Advice
With dry hands, peel back the foil and place the tablet on the tongue. Let it dissolve and swallow with saliva. Water is not required.

benefits.title: Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting
benefits.description: Prevention and control of nausea and vomiting associated with cancer chemotherapy.

benefits.title: Radiotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting
benefits.description: Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with radiotherapy.

benefits.title: Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting
benefits.description: Prevention and management of nausea and vomiting following surgery.

mechanisms.title: Blocks Serotonin Receptors
mechanisms.description: Ondansetron selectively blocks 5-HT3 receptors on gut vagal nerves and within central vomiting pathways.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Vomiting Signals
mechanisms.description: This interrupts serotonin-triggered communication between the gastrointestinal tract and the brain’s vomiting centres.

mechanisms.title: Prevents Nausea and Vomiting
mechanisms.description: Reduced activation of these pathways helps control treatment-associated nausea and vomiting.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Electrolytes
safety_sections.description: Avoid in congenital long-QT syndrome. Low potassium or magnesium and other QT-prolonging medicines increase rhythm risk.

safety_sections.title: Serotonergic Interactions and Apomorphine
safety_sections.description: Do not combine with apomorphine. Seek urgent advice for agitation, fever, tremor or rigidity when taking serotonergic medicines.

safety_sections.title: Liver Disease and Bowel Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Severe liver impairment requires a lower maximum daily dose. Persistent vomiting, severe constipation or abdominal distension needs assessment.

composition_summary: Sucralfate 1 g + oxetacaine 20 mg per 10 mL oral suspension
short_description: Easefate™-O combines sucralfate with oxetacaine for mucosal protection and relief of upper gastrointestinal burning pain.
full_description: Easefate™-O combines sucralfate with oxetacaine for mucosal protection and relief of upper gastrointestinal burning pain. Sucralfate forms a protective barrier over damaged stomach and duodenal lining, while oxetacaine provides local anaesthetic action. The oral formulation supports prescribed management of ulcer-related discomfort and painful gastric irritation.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults being treated for an active peptic ulcer: take 10 mL four times daily, before the three main meals and at bedtime, for the prescribed course. Each dose supplies sucralfate 1 g and oxetacaine 20 mg. Reassess persistent pain or bleeding instead of increasing the dose.

Administration Advice
Shake well and measure with a calibrated medicine cup or oral syringe. Take on an empty stomach, 1 hour before or 2 hours after food. Keep other oral medicines at least 2 hours apart and antacids at least 30 minutes apart.

benefits.title: Peptic Ulcer-Related Discomfort
benefits.description: Protects damaged gastric and duodenal mucosa and relieves associated burning pain.

benefits.title: Gastritis and Acid-Related Irritation
benefits.description: Provides mucosal protection and local relief of painful upper gastrointestinal irritation.

mechanisms.title: Forms a Protective Barrier
mechanisms.description: Sucralfate adheres to damaged mucosa and forms a local protective layer.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Exposure to Irritants
mechanisms.description: The barrier limits contact with acid, pepsin and bile while the lining recovers.

mechanisms.title: Relieves Local Pain
mechanisms.description: Oxetacaine provides local anaesthetic activity that helps reduce burning and discomfort.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Aluminium
safety_sections.description: Sucralfate contains aluminium. Severe kidney impairment requires caution because aluminium may accumulate, particularly with prolonged use.

safety_sections.title: Medicine Absorption
safety_sections.description: Sucralfate can reduce absorption of other medicines. Keep an appropriate gap, commonly at least 2 hours, and follow medicine-specific instructions.

safety_sections.title: Alarm Symptoms and Constipation
safety_sections.description: Persistent pain, weight loss, vomiting blood or black stools need prompt assessment. Constipation may occur.

short_description: Gestemme™-200 contains natural micronised progesterone in softgel capsules for prescribed hormonal support.
full_description: Gestemme™-200 contains natural micronised progesterone in softgel capsules for prescribed hormonal support. Progesterone acts on the uterine lining and supports the secretory changes needed for normal reproductive function. The formulation is used in progesterone-insufficiency states, menstrual management and hormone-treatment programmes under gynaecological supervision.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Oral endometrial protection with oestrogen in postmenopausal adults with an intact uterus: take 1 capsule (200 mg) at bedtime for 12 consecutive days in each 28-day treatment cycle. Fertility and pregnancy support require a separate indication-specific schedule.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole at bedtime. Use by mouth for this regimen; do not switch to vaginal administration unless the prescribed product is approved for that route. Drowsiness can occur.

benefits.title: Progesterone-Related Menstrual Disorders
benefits.description: Management of secondary amenorrhoea and menstrual irregularity associated with progesterone insufficiency.

benefits.title: Endometrial Protection during Oestrogen Therapy
benefits.description: Provides progestogenic support in women with a uterus receiving menopausal oestrogen therapy.

benefits.title: Luteal-Phase Support
benefits.description: Provides progesterone supplementation in specialist reproductive treatment.

mechanisms.title: Activates Progesterone Receptors

mechanisms.title: Supports Endometrial Transformation

mechanisms.title: Provides Progestogenic Support
mechanisms.description: This supports the prescribed cycle or hormone regimen when progesterone activity is required.

safety_sections.title: Unexplained Bleeding and Hormone-Sensitive Disease
safety_sections.description: Investigate unexplained vaginal bleeding before treatment. Relevant cancer history, clotting disorders and liver disease require medical review.

safety_sections.title: Drowsiness and Administration Route
safety_sections.description: Oral progesterone may cause dizziness or sleepiness. Avoid driving if affected. Do not switch between oral and vaginal routes without explicit advice.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy, Excipients and Follow-Up
safety_sections.description: Follow the obstetrician’s instructions in pregnancy. Check excipients for relevant allergy and report persistent bleeding or severe headache.

composition_summary: Progesterone (Natural Micronized) 300 mg Sustained Release Tablets
short_description: Gestemme™-300 provides natural micronised progesterone in a sustained-release oral tablet for prescribed progestogenic support.
full_description: Gestemme™-300 provides natural micronised progesterone in a sustained-release oral tablet for prescribed progestogenic support. Progesterone helps regulate the response of the uterine lining to hormonal changes. The formulation is used in the management of progesterone-related menstrual disturbances and individual hormonal treatment programmes under gynaecological supervision.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with menstrual irregularity due to progesterone insufficiency: take 1 sustained-release tablet (300 mg) once daily in the evening for 10 days per cycle, starting on cycle day 14. Use a separately specified schedule for other indications; this is not the 200 mg HRT regimen.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water at the same time each day, preferably in the evening if it causes drowsiness. Do not crush or chew. This sustained-release tablet is for oral use.

composition_summary: Clindamycin 100 mg + Clotrimazole 100 mg + Tinidazole 100 mg Vaginal Softgels
short_description: Clindaone™-CT combines clindamycin, clotrimazole and tinidazole in vaginal softgels for management of mixed vaginal infections.
full_description: Clindaone™-CT combines clindamycin, clotrimazole and tinidazole in vaginal softgels for management of mixed vaginal infections. Clindamycin acts against susceptible bacteria, clotrimazole targets fungi, and tinidazole acts against anaerobic organisms and susceptible protozoa. The formulation addresses infection-related vaginal discharge, itching and irritation through local vaginal treatment.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: insert 1 vaginal softgel at bedtime for 7 consecutive nights. Persistent or recurrent discharge requires reassessment before another course.

Administration Advice
Wash hands, lie on the back with knees bent and insert the softgel deeply into the vagina. For vaginal use only; do not swallow. Avoid tampons and vaginal douching during treatment. Check the pack for effects on latex barrier contraception.

benefits.title: Mixed Vaginal Infections
benefits.description: Management of vaginal infections involving susceptible bacteria, Candida and anaerobic organisms.

benefits.title: Infection-Related Vaginal Discharge and Irritation
benefits.description: Relieves discharge, itching and irritation associated with mixed infective vaginitis.

mechanisms.title: Inhibits Bacterial Protein Synthesis
mechanisms.description: Clindamycin binds bacterial 50S ribosomes and suppresses growth of susceptible organisms.

mechanisms.title: Disrupts Fungal Membranes
mechanisms.description: Clotrimazole interferes with ergosterol synthesis needed for fungal cell membrane function.

mechanisms.title: Damages Susceptible Microbial DNA
mechanisms.description: Tinidazole forms reactive metabolites in susceptible anaerobic organisms and protozoa.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding
safety_sections.description: Use only after obstetric advice, especially in early pregnancy. Breastfeeding precautions depend on absorption and the prescribed product.

safety_sections.title: Diarrhoea and Local Irritation
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek review for severe diarrhoea or marked vaginal burning. A history of antibiotic-associated colitis requires caution.

safety_sections.title: Barrier Contraception and Alcohol
safety_sections.description: Vaginal bases may weaken latex condoms or diaphragms. Follow pack precautions and avoid alcohol during treatment and for 72 hours afterwards.

composition_summary: Calcium citrate 425 mg + calcitriol 0.25 mcg + magnesium oxide 40 mg + zinc 20 mg per softgel capsule
short_description: Glypocal™-CZ combines calcium citrate, calcitriol, magnesium and zinc for prescribed calcium and bone support.
full_description: Glypocal™-CZ combines calcium citrate, calcitriol, magnesium and zinc for prescribed calcium and bone support. Calcitriol is the active form of vitamin D and promotes intestinal calcium absorption. Calcium supplies a key bone mineral, while magnesium and zinc contribute to normal mineral metabolism and maintenance of bone structure.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 softgel capsule once daily. This provides 0.25 mcg calcitriol per day; adjust continued treatment using serum calcium, phosphate and kidney-function results.

Administration Advice
Swallow whole with water after a meal. Keep at least 4 hours apart from levothyroxine; separate interacting antibiotics according to their prescribing instructions.

benefits.title: Calcium Deficiency Requiring Calcitriol
benefits.description: Provides calcium supplementation with active vitamin D for prescribed management of calcium deficiency.

benefits.title: Bone and Mineral Support
benefits.description: Supports calcium balance and bone mineralisation in medically supervised bone-care programmes.

mechanisms.title: Provides Calcium
mechanisms.description: Calcium citrate supplies calcium for skeletal and physiological requirements.

mechanisms.title: Activates Vitamin D Receptors
mechanisms.description: Calcitriol directly activates vitamin D receptors and increases intestinal calcium and phosphate absorption.

mechanisms.title: Supports Mineral Balance
mechanisms.description: Appropriate replacement supports bone mineralisation when calcium levels and the underlying condition are monitored.

safety_sections.title: Hypercalcaemia and Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Avoid in high blood calcium or vitamin D toxicity. Monitor calcium, phosphate and kidney function as advised.

safety_sections.title: Kidney Disease and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Kidney disease requires specialist guidance. Review digoxin, thiazides and magnesium-containing products because adverse effects may increase.

safety_sections.title: Duplicate Calcium or Vitamin D
safety_sections.description: Do not add other calcium, calcitriol or high-dose vitamin D without advice. Report thirst, constipation, weakness or frequent urination.

benefits.title: Antioxidant and Micronutrient Supplementation
benefits.description: Supplies selected vitamins, minerals and antioxidant ingredients to complement dietary intake.

benefits.title: Reproductive Nutritional Support

mechanisms.title: Supports Cellular Energy Pathways
mechanisms.description: Coenzyme Q10 participates in mitochondrial electron transfer, while carnitine helps transport fatty acids.

mechanisms.title: Provides Antioxidant Nutrients
mechanisms.description: Carotenoids, vitamins C and E, selenium and other ingredients support antioxidant systems.

mechanisms.title: Helps Meet Nutritional Needs
mechanisms.description: Folate and micronutrients contribute to normal metabolic functions when dietary supply is inadequate.

safety_sections.title: Vitamin A and Duplicate Supplements
safety_sections.description: Check total vitamin A, selenium, zinc and vitamin D intake, particularly during pregnancy. Do not combine multiple antioxidant products without advice.

safety_sections.title: Anticoagulants and Other Interactions
safety_sections.description: Coenzyme Q10 may affect warfarin response. Review anticoagulants, thyroid treatment and mineral-sensitive antibiotics with the clinician.

safety_sections.title: Fertility and Cancer Treatment
safety_sections.description: Do not replace fertility investigations or treatment. Obtain oncologist approval before antioxidant supplementation during chemotherapy or radiotherapy.

Adults with heavy menstrual bleeding and cramps: take 1 tablet three times daily during heavy-flow days, for no more than 5 days per cycle. Start when menstrual bleeding begins. Kidney impairment requires a lower or alternative regimen.

Swallow whole with water after food, spacing doses through the day. Do not combine with other NSAID painkillers. Investigate persistent or irregular bleeding before repeating treatment.

mechanisms.title: Controls Bleeding and Pain

safety_sections.title: Blood Clots and Hormonal Contraception
safety_sections.description: Avoid with active or previous thrombosis unless a specialist specifically advises otherwise. Combined hormonal contraception can increase clot risk.

safety_sections.title: Stomach Bleeding and Kidney Disease
safety_sections.description: Mefenamic acid can cause ulcer bleeding and kidney injury. Avoid in active ulcers, severe kidney impairment or NSAID-sensitive asthma.

safety_sections.title: Abnormal Bleeding and Pregnancy

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Urgent Symptoms
safety_sections.description: Do not combine with other NSAIDs. Seek urgent care for chest pain, breathlessness, leg swelling, black stools or visual disturbance.

full_description: Foscore™ contains fosfomycin as granules for oral solution for treatment of acute uncomplicated cystitis in women. Adult women with acute uncomplicated cystitis: take 1 sachet containing 3 g fosfomycin as a single dose. Do not take a daily course or repeat for the same episode without reassessment.

Administration Advice
Dissolve the entire sachet in a glass of water and drink immediately. Take on an empty stomach, 2–3 hours before or after food, preferably at bedtime after emptying the bladder. Do not swallow the dry granules.

benefits.title: Acute Uncomplicated Cystitis

benefits.title: Susceptible-Organism Lower Urinary Tract Infection

safety_sections.title: Kidney Function and Interactions

Dosing and Schedule
Children aged 2 years or older: calculate a total DAILY cyproheptadine dose of 0.25 mg/kg, equivalent to 0.625 mL/kg/day of this syrup, and divide into 2 or 3 doses. Do not use under 2 years; confirm the assumed per-5-mL strength before publication.

Measure each divided dose with an oral syringe and give at the prescribed times. Do not confuse the total daily volume with the volume per dose. Avoid sedating cough medicines and monitor alertness and food intake.

benefits.title: Poor Appetite with Inadequate Intake

benefits.title: Recovery-Related Reduced Intake

safety_sections.title: Underlying Cause and Liver Symptoms

safety_sections.title: Eye Pressure and Healing
safety_sections.description: Prolonged use can raise eye pressure, cause cataract and delay healing. Monitoring is needed, particularly if treatment reaches 10 days.

safety_sections.title: Worsening Symptoms and Contact Lenses
safety_sections.description: Seek prompt review for increasing pain, light sensitivity or reduced vision. Avoid contact lenses during active inflammation or infection.

composition_summary: Ketorolac (0.4% w/v) + Olopatadine (0.1% w/v) Eye Drop
short_description: Olgerix™-KT combines olopatadine with ketorolac for allergic eye symptoms accompanied by inflammation.
full_description: Olgerix™-KT combines olopatadine with ketorolac for allergic eye symptoms accompanied by inflammation. Olopatadine blocks histamine activity and stabilises mast cells, while ketorolac reduces prostaglandin-mediated inflammation. The eye drops help manage allergy-related itching and inflammatory discomfort within a prescribed ophthalmic treatment programme.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: instil 1 drop into each affected eye twice daily for allergy-related itching and inflammation. Reassess persistent symptoms before continuing the NSAID-containing combination.

Administration Advice
Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes.

benefits.title: Allergic Conjunctivitis with Inflammation
benefits.description: Relieves allergic eye itching accompanied by inflammatory symptoms.

benefits.title: Allergy-Related Ocular Discomfort
benefits.description: Provides combined antihistamine and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory treatment for prescribed allergy care.

mechanisms.title: Blocks Histamine and Mast-Cell Responses
mechanisms.description: Olopatadine reduces H1 receptor activation and allergic mediator release.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Prostaglandin Synthesis
mechanisms.description: Ketorolac inhibits cyclo-oxygenase enzymes involved in inflammatory pain.

mechanisms.title: Controls Selected Allergic Inflammation
mechanisms.description: The combined effects may relieve itching and associated inflammatory discomfort when both ingredients are indicated.

safety_sections.title: NSAID Allergy and Bleeding
safety_sections.description: Avoid if previous aspirin or NSAID use caused asthma, swelling or allergy. Inform the doctor about anticoagulants and bleeding disorders.

safety_sections.title: Corneal Damage and Delayed Healing
safety_sections.description: Diabetes, dry eye, corneal disease and prolonged treatment increase risk. Seek urgent review for pain, reduced vision or worsening redness.

safety_sections.title: Contact Lenses and Other Eye Medicines
safety_sections.description: Remove contact lenses and follow the surgeon’s advice on reinsertion. Use with steroid eye drops only under supervision.

composition_summary: Voriconazole 30 mg
short_description: Vorcore™ contains voriconazole, a triazole antifungal used in specialist management of susceptible fungal corneal infections.
full_description: Vorcore™ contains voriconazole, a triazole antifungal used in specialist management of susceptible fungal corneal infections. It inhibits fungal sterol synthesis and disrupts the formation of fungal cell membranes. The preparation forms part of an ophthalmologist-directed treatment programme for fungal keratitis and persistent susceptible corneal infection.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
For a confirmed 1% solution: instil 1 drop into the affected eye every hour initially under corneal-specialist supervision. Reduce frequency only after documented improvement. The final reconstituted concentration must be verified before use.

Administration Advice
Reconstitute aseptically with the specified sterile diluent. A 30 mg vial yields 1% only at a final volume of 3 mL. Use the exact labelled final volume, storage and discard instructions. Keep the dropper tip sterile and separate other eye drops by at least 5 minutes.

benefits.title: Susceptible Fungal Keratitis
benefits.description: Specialist treatment of corneal infection caused by fungi susceptible to voriconazole.

benefits.title: Persistent Fungal Corneal Infection
benefits.description: Provides antifungal treatment in specialist-managed persistent corneal infection involving susceptible organisms.

mechanisms.title: Inhibits Fungal Demethylase
mechanisms.description: Voriconazole inhibits fungal CYP51-dependent lanosterol demethylation.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Ergosterol Formation
mechanisms.description: Sterol depletion disrupts fungal membrane structure and function.

mechanisms.title: Limits Susceptible Fungal Growth
mechanisms.description: Local exposure can control susceptible fungi, with outcome dependent on organism and corneal penetration.

safety_sections.title: Vision-Threatening Infection
safety_sections.description: Fungal keratitis requires urgent follow-up. Worsening pain, opacity or vision needs immediate specialist review.

safety_sections.title: Concentration and Sterility
safety_sections.description: Incorrect dilution or contamination can seriously harm the eye. Do not prepare from a non-ophthalmic product without a validated sterile compounding process.

safety_sections.title: Steroids and Evidence
safety_sections.description: Avoid unsupervised steroid drops. Choice of voriconazole rather than natamycin should reflect organism-specific evidence and susceptibility.

composition_summary: Carboxymethylcellulose 0.3% w/w + glycerine 1% w/w + benzyl alcohol 0.1% w/w Eye Ointment
short_description: Fixtear™ Eye Ointment combines carboxymethylcellulose with glycerine for lubrication of a dry ocular surface.
full_description: Fixtear™ Eye Ointment combines carboxymethylcellulose with glycerine for lubrication of a dry ocular surface. These ingredients retain moisture and reduce friction between the eyelids and the eye. The ophthalmic ointment provides temporary relief of dryness-related irritation, burning and grittiness as part of regular ocular surface care.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
This medicine is for external use only. Take it in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor.

Administration Advice
Confirm whether the product is an ointment, gel or solution before administration. Wash hands, keep the applicator sterile and use after other eye drops when a true ointment is prescribed.

benefits.title: Dry Ocular Surface Discomfort
benefits.description: Lubricates the ocular surface and provides temporary relief of dryness-related irritation.

benefits.title: Dryness-Related Friction and Grittiness
benefits.description: Helps reduce discomfort associated with a poorly lubricated ocular surface.

mechanisms.title: Provides Water-Binding Ingredients
mechanisms.description: Carboxymethylcellulose and glycerine retain water at the ocular surface.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Surface Friction
mechanisms.description: A compatible ophthalmic vehicle supports lubrication during blinking.

mechanisms.title: Improves Temporary Comfort
mechanisms.description: Improved hydration may reduce dryness-related irritation; residence time depends on the actual vehicle.

safety_sections.title: Persistent Pain or Vision Change
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek examination for eye pain, reduced vision, marked redness or symptoms that persist or worsen.

safety_sections.title: Dropper Hygiene and Discard Period
safety_sections.description: Do not touch the tip, share the bottle or use cloudy or discoloured solution. Follow the exact after-opening discard period.

safety_sections.title: Contact Lenses and Blurring
safety_sections.description: Check compatibility with contact lenses and remove them if the label requires it. Wait until temporary blurring clears before driving.

composition_summary: Brinzolamide 10 mg/mL (1% w/v) + brimonidine 2 mg/mL (0.2% w/v) + timolol 5 mg/mL (0.5% w/v) eye drops
short_description: Brinstar™-BT combines brinzolamide, brimonidine and timolol to lower raised intraocular pressure through complementary mechanisms.
full_description: Brinstar™-BT combines brinzolamide, brimonidine and timolol to lower raised intraocular pressure through complementary mechanisms. The ingredients reduce aqueous humour production, while brimonidine also increases uveoscleral outflow. The eye drops provide combination pressure control in open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension within specialist-directed ophthalmic management.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: instil 1 drop into each affected eye twice daily, approximately 12 hours apart. Continue regularly and review intraocular pressure at scheduled visits.

Administration Advice
Wash hands and place the prescribed drop inside the lower eyelid without touching the dropper tip. Close the eye gently. Separate other eye medicines by at least 5 minutes. Close the eyelids and press the inner corner for 1–2 minutes to reduce systemic absorption. Remove contact lenses as directed by the label. Shake if labelled as a suspension.

benefits.title: Open-Angle Glaucoma
benefits.description: Lowers intraocular pressure as part of glaucoma management.

benefits.title: Ocular Hypertension
benefits.description: Reduces raised pressure inside the eye.

mechanisms.title: Inhibits Carbonic Anhydrase
mechanisms.description: Brinzolamide reduces bicarbonate-dependent aqueous humour secretion.

mechanisms.title: Adds Alpha-2 and Beta Receptor Effects
mechanisms.description: Brimonidine reduces secretion and promotes outflow, while timolol reduces beta-mediated aqueous production.

mechanisms.title: Provides Additive Pressure Control
mechanisms.description: The combined effects reduce intraocular fluid accumulation in appropriately selected patients.

safety_sections.title: Asthma and Heart Conditions
safety_sections.description: Timolol-containing drops are contraindicated in asthma, significant bradycardia, certain heart blocks and uncontrolled cardiac failure. Eye drops can have systemic effects.

safety_sections.title: Sulfonamide Reactions and Kidney Disease
safety_sections.description: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors may cause sulfonamide-type hypersensitivity. Severe kidney impairment or acid-base disturbance requires avoidance or specialist review.

safety_sections.title: Infants, Children and Sedation
safety_sections.description: Brimonidine is contraindicated under 2 years and can cause serious sedation or breathing suppression in young children. Paediatric use requires specialist care.

safety_sections.title: Interactions and Monitoring
safety_sections.description: Review other glaucoma drops, cardiac medicines, sedatives and monoamine oxidase inhibitors. Monitor eye pressure, pulse and relevant systemic symptoms.

composition_summary: Hydroquinone 2% + Mometasone 0.1% + Tretinoin 0.025% Cream
short_description: Melacore™ combines hydroquinone, tretinoin and mometasone for short-term treatment of facial melasma under dermatological supervision.
full_description: Melacore™ combines hydroquinone, tretinoin and mometasone for short-term treatment of facial melasma under dermatological supervision. Hydroquinone reduces melanin production, tretinoin promotes epidermal turnover, and mometasone controls inflammation. The cream targets affected facial areas within a pigmentation-care programme that includes consistent sun protection.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply a thin film once nightly to the affected pigmented area only. Review after 2 weeks; the dermatologist must set a short stop date for this mometasone-containing combination.

Administration Advice
Cleanse gently, pat dry and apply sparingly, avoiding the eyelids, lips, nostrils and broken skin. Wash hands afterwards. Use a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen and protective clothing during the day.

benefits.title: Facial Melasma
benefits.description: Short-term management of moderate to severe facial melasma under dermatological supervision.

benefits.title: Melasma-Related Hyperpigmentation
benefits.description: Reduces the appearance of melasma-associated dark patches within a prescribed pigmentation-care routine.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Melanin Production
mechanisms.description: Hydroquinone inhibits tyrosinase-related pathways involved in melanin synthesis.

mechanisms.title: Promotes Epidermal Turnover
mechanisms.description: Tretinoin alters keratinocyte turnover and helps disperse epidermal pigment.

mechanisms.title: Controls Treatment-Related Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Mometasone suppresses local inflammatory responses during the prescribed short course.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding
safety_sections.description: Avoid in pregnancy or while planning pregnancy because the cream contains tretinoin. Seek individual advice during breastfeeding.

safety_sections.title: Steroid and Hydroquinone Risks
safety_sections.description: Prolonged use may cause skin thinning, steroid acne, visible vessels or paradoxical darkening. Do not apply beyond the prescribed areas or duration.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Sun Exposure
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek advice for severe irritation or blue-black pigmentation. Avoid strong exfoliants, waxing and unnecessary sun exposure.

composition_summary: Clindamycin 1% + Adapalene 0.1% Gel
short_description: Clindaone™-AD combines clindamycin with adapalene for treatment of inflammatory and comedonal acne.
full_description: Clindaone™-AD combines clindamycin with adapalene for treatment of inflammatory and comedonal acne. Clindamycin acts against susceptible acne-associated bacteria, while adapalene normalises follicular cell turnover and helps prevent blocked pores. The gel addresses inflamed spots, blackheads and whiteheads as part of a prescribed topical acne-care programme.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older: apply a thin film once nightly over the acne-affected area. Review response at 8–12 weeks and stop prolonged antibiotic use unless specifically renewed.

Administration Advice
Cleanse gently and allow the skin to dry before application. A pea-sized amount is sufficient for the whole face. Avoid eyes, lips, nostrils and damaged skin; wash hands afterwards and use daytime sunscreen.

benefits.title: Inflammatory Acne
benefits.description: Treats acne papules and pustules associated with susceptible acne-related bacteria.

benefits.title: Mixed Comedonal and Inflammatory Acne
benefits.description: Reduces blocked pores and inflammatory lesions through combined antibiotic and retinoid activity.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Susceptible Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Clindamycin inhibits bacterial protein synthesis at the 50S ribosomal subunit.

mechanisms.title: Normalises Follicular Turnover
mechanisms.description: Adapalene acts on retinoid receptors and reduces formation of microcomedones.

mechanisms.title: Reduces Acne Lesions
mechanisms.description: Antibacterial and anti-inflammatory effects work alongside improved follicular clearance.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Skin Irritation
safety_sections.description: Avoid during pregnancy or when planning pregnancy. Dryness, peeling and stinging may occur, particularly early in treatment.

safety_sections.title: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhoea
safety_sections.description: Stop and seek advice for persistent or bloody diarrhoea, even with topical use. A history of antibiotic-related colitis needs review.

safety_sections.title: Resistance and Sun Exposure
safety_sections.description: Use antibiotics only for the prescribed course. The dermatologist may add benzoyl peroxide separately to reduce resistance. Limit sun exposure.

composition_summary: Clobetasol propionate 0.05% w/w + salicylic acid 6.5% w/w ointment
short_description: Clobtos™-SA combines clobetasol propionate with salicylic acid for short-term management of thick, scaly inflammatory skin lesions.
full_description: Clobtos™-SA combines clobetasol propionate with salicylic acid for short-term management of thick, scaly inflammatory skin lesions. Clobetasol provides potent anti-inflammatory activity to reduce redness and itching, while salicylic acid loosens scale and thickened surface skin. The ointment is used on prescribed areas under medical supervision.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply a thin layer to the prescribed thickened plaque once daily for up to 2 weeks, then reassess. Do not increase frequency or treat extensive areas. Confirm the unusual 6.5% salicylic acid declaration before publication.

Administration Advice
Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces.

benefits.title: Thick Psoriatic Plaques
benefits.description: Short-term treatment of limited, thick and scaly psoriasis plaques.

benefits.title: Hyperkeratotic Steroid-Responsive Dermatoses
benefits.description: Reduces inflammation, itching and scale in thickened steroid-responsive skin lesions.

mechanisms.title: Suppresses Local Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Clobetasol activates glucocorticoid receptors and reduces inflammatory mediator production.

mechanisms.title: Loosens Excess Scale
mechanisms.description: Salicylic acid reduces cohesion between surface skin cells and helps remove thick scale.

mechanisms.title: Improves Access to Thickened Skin
mechanisms.description: Reduced scale can improve steroid penetration, requiring careful limits on treated area and duration.

safety_sections.title: Potent Steroid Restrictions
safety_sections.description: Avoid the face, groin, skin folds and broken skin unless specifically directed. Do not use under occlusion or on large areas.

safety_sections.title: Infection and Paediatric Use
safety_sections.description: Do not use for undiagnosed rashes or routine ringworm treatment. Children have greater systemic absorption risk and need specialist advice.

safety_sections.title: Absorption and Toxicity
safety_sections.description: Prolonged use may cause skin thinning or adrenal suppression. Salicylate absorption increases on damaged skin and in kidney impairment.

composition_summary: Glutathione + kojic acid + vitamin A + vitamin C + vitamin E cream
short_description: Glutella-KJ™ combines glutathione, kojic acid and vitamins A, C and E in a cosmetic cream for complexion care.
full_description: Glutella-KJ™ combines glutathione, kojic acid and vitamins A, C and E in a cosmetic cream for complexion care. Kojic acid contributes to an even-looking tone, while the vitamins provide skin-conditioning and antioxidant ingredients. The cream complements a regular skin-care routine focused on dullness, uneven appearance and daily care.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply a thin layer to the intended skin area once nightly. If irritation develops, stop and obtain a skin-care review.

Administration Advice
Apply to clean, dry skin, avoiding eyes, lips and broken skin. Do not layer with other retinoid or exfoliating products without advice. Use a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day.

benefits.title: Uneven-Looking Skin Tone
benefits.description: Provides cosmetic care for a more even-looking complexion.

benefits.title: Dull-Looking Skin
benefits.description: Supplies skin-conditioning and antioxidant ingredients for daily complexion care.

mechanisms.title: Provides Pigment-Related Ingredients
mechanisms.description: Kojic acid can influence tyrosinase activity. The effect depends on concentration and formulation.

mechanisms.title: Supports Surface Antioxidant Care
mechanisms.description: Glutathione and vitamins C and E provide antioxidant ingredients for topical skin care.

mechanisms.title: Conditions the Complexion
mechanisms.description: Regular tolerated use may improve the appearance of dullness and uneven tone without altering natural skin colour permanently.

safety_sections.title: Patch Testing and Irritation
safety_sections.description: Patch test before wider use. Stop for persistent burning, rash, swelling or significant irritation. Avoid use on damaged skin.

safety_sections.title: Sun Protection and Other Actives
safety_sections.description: Use appropriate daytime sun protection. Introduce other exfoliating or retinoid products cautiously to limit irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Persistent Pigmentation
safety_sections.description: Seek advice before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Persistent, changing or symptomatic pigmentation needs dermatological assessment.

composition_summary: Tranexamic acid + kojic acid + alpha-arbutin + niacinamide + flower acid + vitamin C in a facial serum base
short_description: Traxpause™-KC combines tranexamic acid, kojic acid, alpha-arbutin, niacinamide, flower acid and vitamin C in a facial serum for pigmentation care.
full_description: Traxpause™-KC combines tranexamic acid, kojic acid, alpha-arbutin, niacinamide, flower acid and vitamin C in a facial serum for pigmentation care. The formula brings together pigment-focused and skin-conditioning ingredients to address the appearance of uneven tone and post-blemish marks as part of a consistent skin-care routine.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Apply 2–3 drops as a thin layer to the intended facial area once nightly. Stop if persistent burning or redness develops.

Administration Advice
Apply to clean, dry skin and allow it to absorb before moisturiser. Avoid eyes, lips and broken skin. Use a suitable broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day.

benefits.title: Uneven Facial Tone
benefits.description: Provides targeted cosmetic care for uneven-looking facial pigmentation.

benefits.title: Post-Blemish Dark Marks
benefits.description: Helps improve the appearance of residual dark marks following blemishes.

mechanisms.title: Modulates Pigment Signalling
mechanisms.description: Topical tranexamic acid may influence plasmin-related pathways involved in UV-associated pigmentation.

mechanisms.title: Targets Pigment Formation and Transfer
mechanisms.description: Kojic acid and arbutin influence tyrosinase-related processes. Niacinamide may reduce melanosome transfer.

mechanisms.title: Supports Surface Skin Renewal
mechanisms.description: Vitamin C and the specified acid blend may support antioxidant care and surface appearance, depending on formulation.

safety_sections.title: Patch Testing and Irritation
safety_sections.description: Patch test before wider use. Stop for persistent burning, rash, swelling or significant irritation. Avoid use on damaged skin.

safety_sections.title: Sun Protection and Other Actives
safety_sections.description: Use appropriate daytime sun protection. Introduce other exfoliating or retinoid products cautiously to limit irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Persistent Pigmentation
safety_sections.description: Seek advice before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Persistent, changing or symptomatic pigmentation needs dermatological assessment.

composition_summary: L-Glutathione 600 mg + Silybum marianum extract 250 mg + N-Acetyl L-Cysteine 125 mg + Co-Enzyme Q10 60 mg + Alpha lipoic acid 50 mg + Pinus gerardiana bark extract 50 mg + Curcuma longa rhizome extract 50 mg + Phycocyanin from spirulina plantesis dried powder 50 mg + Vitamin C (L-ASCORBIC ACID) 40 mg + Grape seed extract 15 mg + Camellia sinensis-tea catechins 10 mg + Vitamin E 10 mg + Provitamin A 4.8 mg + Astaxanthin 4 mg + Lycopene 2 mg + Folic acid 0.1 mg
short_description: Glutella Plus™ combines glutathione, N-acetylcysteine, coenzyme Q10, alpha-lipoic acid, botanical extracts, carotenoids and vitamins for antioxidant nutritional support.
full_description: Glutella Plus™ combines glutathione, N-acetylcysteine, coenzyme Q10, alpha-lipoic acid, botanical extracts, carotenoids and vitamins for antioxidant nutritional support. The formulation supplies multiple ingredients involved in cellular antioxidant and metabolic pathways. It complements a balanced diet and provides supplemental nutrients within a daily skin and general-wellness nutrition programme.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Take one tablet daily with water, preferably after a meal.

Administration Advice
Take with or immediately after a meal. Review continued use with the treating clinician and avoid overlapping supplements.

benefits.title: Antioxidant Nutritional Supplementation
benefits.description: Provides antioxidant ingredients to complement daily dietary intake.

benefits.title: Skin Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Supplies nutrients involved in normal cellular antioxidant and skin-related nutritional functions.

mechanisms.title: Provides Antioxidant Ingredients
mechanisms.description: The listed ingredients supply antioxidant molecules or substrates involved in cellular protective pathways.

mechanisms.title: Supports Endogenous Systems
mechanisms.description: Glutathione and related nutritional pathways participate in handling reactive oxygen species.

mechanisms.title: Complements Nutritional Intake
mechanisms.description: Supplementation may support assessed dietary gaps. Biochemical activity does not establish a cosmetic or disease-treatment benefit.

safety_sections.title: Cancer Treatment and Other Medicines
safety_sections.description: Obtain clinician approval before use with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, anticoagulants or glucose-lowering medicines. Supplement interactions may be clinically important.

safety_sections.title: Allergy, Liver and Kidney Problems
safety_sections.description: Check all ingredients for allergy. Seek advice with liver or kidney disease and stop for jaundice, severe nausea or persistent abdominal pain.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Evidence Limits
safety_sections.description: Avoid unsupervised use in pregnancy, breastfeeding or children. Skin-lightening, anti-ageing and disease-treatment claims are not established for this exact formulation.

composition_summary: Luliconazole 1% Cream
short_description: Lulifite™ contains luliconazole, a topical antifungal for treatment of dermatophyte skin infections.
full_description: Lulifite™ contains luliconazole, a topical antifungal for treatment of dermatophyte skin infections. It inhibits fungal sterol synthesis and disrupts fungal cell membrane formation. The cream targets the organisms responsible for ringworm of the body, fungal groin infection and athlete’s foot, helping relieve infection-associated itching and scaling.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: apply once daily for 1 week for tinea corporis or cruris and for 2 weeks for interdigital tinea pedis.

Administration Advice
Wash and dry the area thoroughly. Apply a thin layer over the affected skin and approximately 2.5 cm of surrounding skin. Wash hands afterwards. For external skin use only.

benefits.title: Tinea Corporis and Tinea Cruris
benefits.description: Treats susceptible dermatophyte infections affecting the body and groin.

benefits.title: Interdigital Tinea Pedis
benefits.description: Treats fungal infection between the toes caused by susceptible dermatophytes.

mechanisms.title: Blocks Ergosterol Synthesis
mechanisms.description: Luliconazole inhibits fungal lanosterol demethylase.

mechanisms.title: Disrupts Fungal Membranes
mechanisms.description: Reduced ergosterol impairs the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.

mechanisms.title: Controls Susceptible Dermatophytes
mechanisms.description: Membrane disruption limits fungal growth and helps resolve the infection during the prescribed course.

safety_sections.title: Correct Diagnosis
safety_sections.description: Do not treat undiagnosed rashes indefinitely. Scalp, nail, extensive or recurrent fungal infection may require a different treatment.

safety_sections.title: Local Irritation and Application Site
safety_sections.description: Avoid eyes, mouth and vaginal use. Stop for severe burning, rash or swelling.

safety_sections.title: Steroid Combinations and Special Populations
safety_sections.description: Do not add a steroid cream unless specifically directed. Pregnancy, breastfeeding and use in children require product-specific advice.

composition_summary: Deflazacort 6 mg per tablet
short_description: Deftos™-6 contains deflazacort, a prescription corticosteroid that reduces inflammation and excessive immune activity.
full_description: Deftos™-6 contains deflazacort, a prescription corticosteroid that reduces inflammation and excessive immune activity. It acts through glucocorticoid receptors to suppress inflammatory mediators and immune responses. The tablet is used in the management of steroid-responsive inflammatory, allergic and autoimmune conditions as part of an individual medical treatment plan.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: the total dose is 6–90 mg daily according to the inflammatory or autoimmune condition and its severity. Each tablet supplies 6 mg. Start at the indication-specific prescribed dose, then reduce to the lowest effective dose; prolonged treatment requires a planned gradual taper.

Administration Advice
Take the prescribed total daily dose with food, preferably in the morning when given once daily. Swallow with water. Do not stop abruptly after prolonged treatment; follow the written taper.

benefits.title: Steroid-Responsive Inflammatory and Allergic Disorders
benefits.description: Controls inflammation in conditions requiring systemic corticosteroid treatment.

benefits.title: Autoimmune Disorders
benefits.description: Suppresses excessive immune activity in specialist-managed autoimmune disease.

mechanisms.title: Activates Glucocorticoid Receptors
mechanisms.description: The active metabolite binds intracellular glucocorticoid receptors.

mechanisms.title: Changes Inflammatory Gene Activity
mechanisms.description: This reduces production of inflammatory mediators and modifies immune-cell responses.

mechanisms.title: Suppresses Excess Inflammation
mechanisms.description: The resulting effect reduces steroid-responsive inflammation and immune activity.

safety_sections.title: Infection and Vaccination
safety_sections.description: Steroids can mask or worsen infection. Report fever and exposure to chickenpox or measles. Live vaccines may be unsuitable during immunosuppressive doses.

safety_sections.title: Glucose, Bone and Eye Effects
safety_sections.description: Monitor blood glucose, blood pressure and relevant bone or eye risks during continued therapy. Mood and sleep changes may occur.

safety_sections.title: Adrenal Suppression and Withdrawal
safety_sections.description: Do not stop prolonged treatment abruptly. Illness or surgery may require additional steroid cover and an individual taper.

composition_summary: Glutathione + kojic acid + vitamin C + vitamin E + niacinamide face wash
short_description: Glutella™-N combines glutathione, kojic acid, vitamins C and E, and niacinamide in a cosmetic face wash for daily cleansing and complexion care.
full_description: Glutella™-N combines glutathione, kojic acid, vitamins C and E, and niacinamide in a cosmetic face wash for daily cleansing and complexion care. It removes surface impurities and excess oil while providing skin-conditioning ingredients. The formula complements a routine focused on clean skin and a fresh, even-looking appearance.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Use once in the morning and once in the evening. Reduce to once daily if dryness develops.

Administration Advice
Wet the face, massage a small amount over the skin, then rinse thoroughly and pat dry. Avoid the eye area and follow with a suitable moisturiser.

benefits.title: Daily Facial Cleansing
benefits.description: Removes surface dirt, impurities and excess oil.

benefits.title: Dull or Uneven-Looking Complexion
benefits.description: Provides cleansing and cosmetic care for a fresh, even-looking appearance.

mechanisms.title: Lifts Surface Impurities
mechanisms.description: The cleansing base helps remove dirt, oil and other surface residues.

mechanisms.title: Provides Brief Ingredient Contact
mechanisms.description: Kojic acid, vitamins and glutathione contact the surface during washing, with effects dependent on formulation.

mechanisms.title: Leaves Skin Cleansed
mechanisms.description: Rinsing removes loosened impurities. Skin-conditioning ingredients may support a comfortable after-feel.

safety_sections.title: Irritation and Eye Contact
safety_sections.description: Avoid the eye area. Rinse thoroughly after accidental contact and stop for persistent burning or rash.

safety_sections.title: Over-Cleansing and Other Actives
safety_sections.description: Excessive washing or combining several exfoliating products may cause dryness and barrier irritation.

safety_sections.title: Pigmentation and Product Details
safety_sections.description: Do not rely on a cleanser to treat persistent pigmentation. Concentrations and finished-product testing determine any stronger claims.

composition_summary: L-Glutathione 500 mg + Alpha-Lipoic Acid 100 mg + Resveratrol 10 mg + Astaxanthin 4 mg Tablets
short_description: Glutella™-A combines glutathione, alpha-lipoic acid, resveratrol and astaxanthin for supplemental antioxidant nutrition.
full_description: Glutella™-A combines glutathione, alpha-lipoic acid, resveratrol and astaxanthin for supplemental antioxidant nutrition. These ingredients participate in cellular antioxidant pathways and complement dietary antioxidant intake. The tablet brings together four antioxidant ingredients in a single formulation for inclusion in a balanced skin and general-wellness nutritional programme.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 tablet once daily. Do not add other glutathione or antioxidant combinations without reviewing the total daily intake.

Administration Advice
Swallow the tablet with water after a meal. Maintain a consistent daily schedule.

benefits.title: Antioxidant Nutritional Supplementation
benefits.description: Provides antioxidant ingredients to complement daily dietary intake.

benefits.title: Skin Nutritional Support
benefits.description: Supplies nutrients involved in normal cellular antioxidant and skin-related nutritional functions.

Adults: apply a thin layer once daily for a short course of no more than 7 days before review, only to a diagnosed condition requiring both ingredients. Do not renew for an undiagnosed or spreading rash.

Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces. Do not cover with an airtight dressing unless specifically directed.

Apply a thin layer to the acne-affected area twice daily, morning and evening. Review at 8–12 weeks and reassess before extending the antibiotic course.

Clean and dry the area before applying a thin layer. Wash hands afterwards unless treating the hands. Avoid eyes, mouth and other mucosal surfaces. Apply over the acne-affected area rather than only individual spots when directed.

Adults and adolescents aged 12 years or older with seasonal allergic rhinitis: take 1 tablet (120 mg) once daily. Kidney impairment requires review of a lower starting strength.

Swallow with water before a meal. Do not take with apple, orange or grapefruit juice. Keep aluminium- or magnesium-containing antacids at least 2 hours apart.

Adults and older children: use 1–2 sprays in each nostril up to 4 times daily as needed. Infants require an age-appropriate saline-drop preparation and a separately prescribed technique.

Gently clear the nose, insert the nozzle just inside the nostril and spray without forceful sniffing. Clean the nozzle after use and do not share the bottle.

full_description: Stomazo™-D combines esomeprazole with domperidone for prescribed management of reflux associated with regurgitation, nausea and upper gastrointestinal motility symptoms. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion, while domperidone promotes upper digestive tract movement. The capsule provides combined acid-suppressing and prokinetic activity within a reflux-treatment programme.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1 capsule once daily before breakfast. This supplies the full 30 mg daily domperidone dose. Use for the shortest necessary period and review within 7 days.

Administration Advice
Swallow the capsule whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush, chew or combine with another domperidone-containing medicine.

safety_sections.title: Symptoms Requiring Investigation
safety_sections.description: Difficulty swallowing, weight loss, persistent vomiting, black stools or vomiting blood require medical assessment. Symptom relief does not exclude serious disease.

safety_sections.title: Heart Rhythm and Interactions
safety_sections.description: Domperidone may cause serious rhythm disturbances. Avoid with QT prolongation, significant electrolyte disturbance, potent CYP3A4 inhibitors or other QT-prolonging medicines.

safety_sections.title: Dose, Duration and Liver Disease
safety_sections.description: Do not exceed 30 mg domperidone daily. Use for the shortest period, usually no longer than 7 days without review. Avoid in moderate or severe liver impairment.

safety_sections.title: Gastrointestinal Obstruction
safety_sections.description: Do not use if there is gastrointestinal bleeding, mechanical obstruction or perforation. Persistent nausea requires investigation.

short_description: Sultics™-375 contains sultamicillin, an oral prodrug that releases ampicillin and sulbactam after absorption.
full_description: Sultics™-375 contains sultamicillin, an oral prodrug that releases ampicillin and sulbactam after absorption. Ampicillin inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis, while sulbactam blocks certain beta-lactamase enzymes. The tablet is used in prescribed treatment of susceptible bacterial infections affecting the respiratory tract, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults: take 1–2 tablets (375–750 mg) twice daily, according to infection severity. Continue for the prescribed course; streptococcal infections require at least 10 days. Significant kidney impairment requires a longer dosing interval.

Administration Advice
Swallow with water at evenly spaced times, with or without food. Complete the prescribed course and avoid sharing antibiotics.

composition_summary: Gemcitabine 200 mg / 1 g Injection
short_description: Gemcore™ contains gemcitabine, an intravenous antimetabolite used in cancer chemotherapy.
full_description: Gemcore™ contains gemcitabine, an intravenous antimetabolite used in cancer chemotherapy. Its active metabolites interfere with DNA synthesis and limit the multiplication of cancer cells. The injection is used in oncologist-directed treatment regimens for pancreatic, non-small cell lung, breast and ovarian cancers, including prescribed combination chemotherapy.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults — pancreatic cancer: 1000 mg/m² once weekly for 7 weeks, then 1 week off; subsequently on days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle. NSCLC with cisplatin: 1250 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 every 21 days, or 1000 mg/m² on days 1, 8 and 15 every 28 days. Breast cancer with paclitaxel: 1250 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 every 21 days. Ovarian cancer with carboplatin: 1000 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 every 21 days. Adjust or withhold according to blood counts and toxicity.

Administration Advice
Give by intravenous infusion over 30 minutes in an oncology unit. Calculate the required milligrams from body surface area and select sufficient 200 mg and/or 1 g vials. Reconstitute and dilute by the exact vial instructions; use cytotoxic handling precautions.

short_description: Oxalitos™ 50 contains oxaliplatin, a platinum-based chemotherapy medicine used in colorectal cancer treatment.
full_description: Oxalitos™ 50 contains oxaliplatin, a platinum-based chemotherapy medicine used in colorectal cancer treatment. It forms cross-links in DNA and interferes with cancer-cell division. The injection is used with fluorouracil and leucovorin in oncologist-directed regimens for adjuvant treatment of stage III colon cancer and advanced colorectal cancer.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults receiving FOLFOX for colorectal cancer: administer 85 mg/m² intravenously on day 1 of each 14-day cycle with leucovorin and fluorouracil. Calculate the dose from body surface area; adjust or withhold for neuropathy, blood counts, severe kidney impairment or other toxicity.

Administration Advice
Infuse over 2 hours through an oncology service, before fluorouracil. Use the pack-specified 5% glucose dilution. Do not use sodium chloride or other chloride-containing solutions, and do not mix with alkaline preparations. Use the required number of vials for the calculated dose.

composition_summary: Bevacizumab 400 mg/16 mL (25 mg/mL) concentrate for intravenous infusion
short_description: Bevacore™ 400 contains bevacizumab, a monoclonal antibody that blocks vascular endothelial growth factor.
full_description: Bevacore™ 400 contains bevacizumab, a monoclonal antibody that blocks vascular endothelial growth factor. By reducing signalling for new blood vessel formation, it targets the vascular support of tumour growth. The concentrate is used for intravenous infusion in oncologist-directed combination treatment of colorectal, non-squamous lung, ovarian and cervical cancers.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults — metastatic colorectal cancer: 5 mg/kg every 2 weeks with bolus-IFL chemotherapy, or 10 mg/kg every 2 weeks with FOLFOX4. First-line non-squamous NSCLC: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks with carboplatin/paclitaxel. Persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks with paclitaxel/cisplatin or paclitaxel/topotecan. Platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian cancer: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks with carboplatin/gemcitabine for 6–10 cycles, then 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks alone. Select the protocol matching the indication and treatment setting; withhold for protocol-defined toxicity.

Administration Advice
Dilute the calculated weight-based dose in 0.9% sodium chloride and give by intravenous infusion only. Infuse the first dose over 90 minutes, the second over 60 minutes if tolerated, then over 30 minutes if tolerated. Do not give as an IV push or intraocular injection.

full_description: Oncogras™ contains filgrastim, a granulocyte colony-stimulating factor that stimulates neutrophil production in the bone marrow. It supports recovery of infection-fighting white blood cells during chemotherapy-associated and other neutropenic conditions. The injection is also used in specialist stem-cell mobilisation and severe chronic neutropenia care.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Chemotherapy-associated neutropenia: start at 5 mcg/kg once daily, beginning at least 24 hours after cytotoxic chemotherapy. Continue until the post-nadir neutrophil count recovers, using blood-count monitoring. At 300 mcg/mL, 5 mcg/kg equals 0.0167 mL/kg; a trained professional must calculate and measure the dose. Do not give within 24 hours before chemotherapy.

Administration Advice
Administer by subcutaneous injection or the label-approved intravenous infusion route. Refrigerate as directed, do not shake and use aseptic technique. A 300 mcg vial is not a fixed dose for every patient; follow vial-specific dilution and discard instructions.

composition_summary: Temozolomide 100 mg per capsule
short_description: Temzoro™-100 contains temozolomide, an oral alkylating anticancer medicine used in malignant glioma treatment.
full_description: Temzoro™-100 contains temozolomide, an oral alkylating anticancer medicine used in malignant glioma treatment. It is converted into an active compound that damages tumour-cell DNA and interferes with cell replication. The capsule forms part of oncologist-directed treatment for glioblastoma and anaplastic astrocytoma, including radiotherapy-associated and maintenance regimens.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma: 75 mg/m² once daily for 42–49 days with radiotherapy. Start maintenance 4 weeks later at 150 mg/m² once daily on days 1–5 of each 28-day cycle; increase to 200 mg/m² from cycle 2 only if counts and tolerability meet protocol criteria. Calculate capsule combinations from body surface area; adjust or withhold for toxicity.

Administration Advice
Take the entire calculated daily dose at one time with water, consistently on an empty stomach, preferably at bedtime to reduce nausea. Swallow capsules whole; do not open or crush. Use prescribed antiemetics and infection prophylaxis. Do not repeat a dose after vomiting.

benefits.title: Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
benefits.description: Used with radiotherapy followed by maintenance treatment within an oncology protocol.

benefits.title: Anaplastic Astrocytoma
benefits.description: Used in specialist treatment regimens for refractory anaplastic astrocytoma.

mechanisms.title: Forms an Active Alkylating Compound
mechanisms.description: Temozolomide converts spontaneously to MTIC at physiological pH.

mechanisms.title: Methylates Tumour-Cell DNA
mechanisms.description: Reactive products add methyl groups to DNA bases, including guanine.

mechanisms.title: Disrupts Replication
mechanisms.description: Unrepaired DNA lesions can trigger cell-cycle arrest and death in susceptible tumour cells.

safety_sections.title: Blood Counts and Infection
safety_sections.description: Myelosuppression can be severe. Regular blood counts are required, and fever or bleeding needs urgent oncology review.

safety_sections.title: Pneumocystis Prophylaxis
safety_sections.description: Pneumocystis pneumonia prophylaxis is required during the concomitant radiotherapy phase and may need continuation with persistent lymphopenia.

safety_sections.title: Liver Injury and Hypersensitivity
safety_sections.description: Monitor liver function. Avoid in relevant temozolomide or dacarbazine hypersensitivity and report jaundice or severe rash.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Safe Handling
safety_sections.description: May harm a fetus. Follow contraception, fertility and breastfeeding advice. Avoid contact with powder from damaged capsules.

composition_summary: Paclitaxel 30 mg per injection vial
short_description: Pacli-one™-30 contains paclitaxel, a taxane chemotherapy medicine that stabilises microtubules and interferes with cancer-cell division.
full_description: Pacli-one™-30 contains paclitaxel, a taxane chemotherapy medicine that stabilises microtubules and interferes with cancer-cell division. The injection is used in oncologist-directed treatment regimens for breast cancer and non-small cell lung cancer. It provides cytotoxic treatment as part of an individual cancer-care programme under specialist supervision.
dosage_guidance:
Dosing and Schedule
Your doctor or nurse will give you this medicine. Kindly do not self administer.

Administration Advice
For intravenous infusion in an oncology unit only. The oncologist must calculate the dose in mg/m² using the confirmed formulation and cancer protocol. Follow its exact dilution, filtration, premedication and infusion instructions; vial strength alone does not determine the dose.

benefits.title: Breast Cancer
benefits.description: Used in oncologist-directed chemotherapy regimens for breast cancer.

benefits.title: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
benefits.description: Used in prescribed combination chemotherapy for non-small cell lung cancer.

mechanisms.title: Binds Microtubules
mechanisms.description: Paclitaxel binds beta-tubulin and promotes microtubule assembly.

mechanisms.title: Prevents Microtubule Disassembly
mechanisms.description: It stabilises microtubules and disrupts their normal dynamic function.

mechanisms.title: Interrupts Cell Division
mechanisms.description: Abnormal spindle function causes cell-cycle arrest and can lead to death of susceptible cells.

safety_sections.title: Formulation and Infusion Reactions
safety_sections.description: Severe hypersensitivity can occur. Conventional solvent-based products generally need corticosteroid and antihistamine premedication. Follow the exact formulation label.

safety_sections.title: Blood Counts and Infection
safety_sections.description: Check neutrophil and platelet counts before treatment. Fever or unexpected bleeding needs prompt oncology assessment.

safety_sections.title: Neuropathy, Liver and Cardiac Effects
safety_sections.description: Report progressive numbness, marked weakness or palpitations. Liver impairment and neurological toxicity may require dose changes.

safety_sections.title: Pregnancy and Administration Safety
safety_sections.description: Follow contraception and breastfeeding restrictions. Monitor the infusion site for extravasation and use cytotoxic handling precautions.
